limite: The content stays in this tab. No application is sent or submitted.
ayuda_texto: In the Pool preparation, download the draft to continue later. Open that file here and check the requirements, deadlines and documents before submitting through the appropriate procedure. The text summary cannot restore the preparation.
archivo_pista: Select the draft downloaded when preparing the application, up to 2 MiB. The text summary cannot be used.
recuperado: Preparation restored. Check its details and the current rules before continuing.
error_archivo: The preparation could not be restored. Select the downloaded draft, check that it is under 2 MiB and try again.
datos_vacios: Choose a file to see its content.
segun_archivo: Restored information; compare it with the current announcement.
lectura: Reading status stated in the file
lectura_si: Rules marked as reviewed. Check them before submitting the application.
lectura_no: There is no record that you have reviewed the rules.
sin_datos: This section of the file contains no data.
ruta_no_verificada: Unchecked path. The document is not opened or downloaded.
archivo_metadatos: {nombre} · Stated size: {tamano} bytes. Open the original to view the document.
guardado: File downloaded. The application still needs to be submitted.
pendiente_fuente: Check the current rules and their requirements.
pendiente_formulario: Obtain the form and documents accepted by HR.
pendiente_identidad: Establish identity and, where applicable, representation. Being an employee is not required to prepare an application.
pendiente_circuito: Check the applicable fee or exemption and submit the application as stated in the announcement.
origen_json: Choose a call to prepare an application
